title: The differential on a labelled total-bar generator
statement: In the bar total [def-sc-preorder-bar-total], the differential on a generator in horizontal degree p+1 is the finite alternating sum of its p+2 faces plus (-1)^(p+1) times its internal differential. In horizontal degree zero only the internal differential remains.

source.place: The source-bar, least-block unit contraction, and finite-cone-block paragraphs.

proof.text: Express the total generator as evaluation of a coproduct inclusion followed by its diagonal inclusion. The first total differential is the horizontal alternating face-map differential, hence the finite sum of the diagram face maps with coefficients (-1)^a. The second is the internal differential times the prescribed total sign; commute it past the coproduct inclusion using its cochain-map equation. At horizontal degree zero the first differential is zero. The total differential is the sum of these two terms.

lemma ιTerm_d_succ (p : ℕ) (q n : ℤ) (h : q - ((p + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) = n)
    (σ : Fin (p + 1 + 1) →o I) :
    ιTerm D (p + 1) q n h σ ≫ (total D).d n (n + 1) =
      (∑ a : Fin (p + 2), ((-1 : ℤ) ^ a.val) •
        ((D.map (faceArrow σ a)).f q ≫
          ιTerm D p q (n + 1) (by omega) (σ.comp (SimplexCategory.δ a).toOrderHom))) +
      ((-1 : ℤ) ^ (p + 1)) • ((D.obj (σ 0)).d q (q + 1) ≫
        ιTerm D (p + 1) (q + 1) (n + 1) (by omega) σ)
